review.note: Reviewed G2 per Amendment 1. Sheets are div.page-sheet siblings of EditorContent inside .editor-paper (aria-hidden, no text, pointer-events none, rendered only in pages mode): outside ProseMirror so not in doc/undo/saves/exports/selection/copy/spellcheck/word counts. Print CSS hides .page-sheet. Flat square var(--paper) boxes, theme via token; no motion. sameBoundaries running-total drift change is small and unit tested; no zoom-1 measuring so WebKit numbers unchanged. Native PNGs (75/150 dark, gap-caret-a) show grey gaps and page starts where expected (native evidence reviewed from logs/PNGs only, not rerun). Own Chromium build/port 1681: pages-zoom pass (all zooms), pages-gap 9/9, pages 6/6, page-break 3/3, footnotes 4/4, split-view 16/16. Note: an earlier pages-gap run showed 3 ENOENT failures from my own concurrent runs wiping the results dir; clean rerun passed.

log.note: G2 per PLAN.md Amendment 1. What changed: (1) Drawing. src/Writer.tsx renders one div.page-sheet per page (aria-hidden, top = page * (height + gap) px) as the first children of .editor-paper. In src/editor/editor.css the .is-paged .editor-paper repeating-linear-gradient is replaced by .is-paged .page-sheet {position:absolute; left/right 0; height var(--page-height); background var(--paper); pointer-events none}, and sheets are hidden in print. Real boxes zoom in WebKit; gradient px stops did not. (2) Chromium drift. src/editor/pagination.ts: the private 'same' check becomes the exported sameBoundaries, which compares spacer heights as a running total. At fit zoom 1.1495 each spacer was ~0.3 px off, under the 0.5 tolerance, so it never re-planned and pages drifted 4 px by page 13. WebKit measurement is unchanged (no zoom-1 measuring). Unit tests: 3 sameBoundaries cases in src/editor/pagination.test.ts. Verified: npx vitest run src/editor/pagination.test.ts -> 21 pass; npx tsc --noEmit -p . -> 0. Fail-first: tests/pages-zoom.spec.ts on the untouched build (ui4-g2/dist-base, config ui4-g2/browser.config.mjs) -> exit 1 (pw-zoom-base.log); on the fix (ui4-g2/dist, ui4-g2/fix.config.mjs) -> pass at 50/75/100/125/150 (max layout 0, drawn 0.12, 0 crossings, pixel gaps exact). Regression: pages, page-break, footnotes, pages-gap and performance specs on the fix -> 28 passed (pw-fix-suite.log). Native WebKit (screen unlocked, ui4-g2/smoke-build.sh, python3 node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui4-g/native-gate.py --binary g2=<abs>/ui4-g2/bin/folio-g2): grey bands where expected within 0.2 px at every zoom, page-start drift <= 1 px, zero flags True. Untouched G1 binary, same scan (--rescan ui4-g1/native-zoom-results2.json): False, deltas -159/+263/-359 px. pages-probe phase: all six caret flags true (native-gate-probe.log). The 3.png repro view now shows the line on page 2 below a correctly drawn gap (ui4-g2/native-screens/gap-caret-a.png). Gate improvements: scrollerTop recorded; ink check works in dark mode and covers only the checked band; --rescan.
